name: Mannequin Syndrome
detailed_description:
Mannequin Syndrome

They were never meant to move.

Syntrax Systems set out to revolutionize retail with their AI project MANE—lifelike mannequins that could learn, adapt, and interact with customers. What was meant to be the future of shopping turned into a nightmare.

Now these mannequins roam abandoned malls and research sites, hunting with an intelligence that grows stronger after every encounter. What was designed to sell products now sells only fear.

Your Mission

You are part of a Syntrax containment unit, humanity’s last line of defense. Infiltrate compromised sites, uncover what went wrong, and complete shutdown procedures before the corruption spreads beyond control.

But remember—these mannequins are watching. They learn from every move you make.

Core Features

  • Solo or Co-Op (1–4 Players) – Play alone for an intense survival experience, or team up with friends where communication is key.

  • Tense Horror Atmosphere – Explore dark, atmospheric environments where every shadow could hide danger.

  • Objective-Driven Missions – Complete critical tasks to secure each facility while evading relentless threats.

  • Smart, Adaptive AI – Mannequins remember your actions, change tactics, and outsmart predictable behavior.

  • Shutdown Protocols – Survival isn’t enough; you must complete complex procedures to contain the threat.

  • Standalone Chapters – Each mission tells its own story while contributing to the larger mystery.

Discover the Truth

Browse a Syntrax worker’s laptop from the main menu to uncover how the disaster began.

During missions, collect survivor notes that reveal mannequin behavior, weaknesses, and the events leading to the outbreak. Every clue brings you closer to stopping the Syndrome.

Future Plans

  • New Locations – The current map is a mall, with more unique environments coming in future updates.

  • Mannequin Variants – New mannequin types with distinct hunting patterns will challenge your survival strategies.

  • Dynamic Threat System – AI updates will make encounters unpredictable, ensuring no two runs are alike.

  • Expanding the Mystery – The full truth may never be fully uncovered, but future updates will reveal more pieces of the puzzle.

The mannequins no longer stand still.
They move with purpose. They stalk with intelligence.
And they kill with precision.

Mannequin Syndrome – When retail horror comes alive.
